messages:
maria: dropping a fresh pass on the model catalog compare UI. goals: keep rows single-line at medium widths, make perf badges scannable, and make pinning behavior obvious across views. quick takes?

arpit: single-line is important. current filters wrap and cause visual jump. propose collapsing filter chips into a single pill with "+N more" and an inline chevron to expand a floating tray.

sasha: +1 for the tray. accessibility: the tray must be reachable by keyboard and announce when opened (aria-live) and set focus to first interactive element. also aria-label the chevron as "Show hidden filters".

lee: perf badges: the table currently shows p50/p95/p99 — it's dense and hard to parse. recommend showing a single condensed pill (colored) with an indicator glyph and tooltip that expands to full metrics. e.g., pill shows a lightning bolt icon + color.

arpit: agree. Also request a legend toggle above the table header that can be collapsed. That prevents users from hunting for meaning.

maria: note on pinning: interaction confusion when users pin in catalog then compare shows a different version. My proposal: pin is global by default and surfaced with a small pin icon + tooltip "Pinned (global)". In compare, support a local override per session that shows a thin outline pin and text "override". We should show which is active in CSV export.

sasha: CSV export: add a column "version_origin" with values "pinned", "selected", "latest". engineers: confirm schema ok.

arpit: microcopy nit: "Pin version" vs "Lock version". prefer "Pin version" to keep it light. tooltip: "Pin sets the default version in catalog and compare; users can override locally."

maria: accessibility color note: yellow badge fails contrast on our background. options: darken yellow or add a 1px outline. prefer outline to keep palette.

lee: keyboard flow bug: when filter tray is open, tab cycles inside and user cannot reach table header. must not trap focus; instead use focus-skip link or ensure tray only traps when modal.

ui-bot: design-review: add figma link + annotate pin icon states + show compact legend placement. tag eng-catalog for CSV change.

maria: action items:
- maria: update figma with tray pattern and pin states + copy variants (Pin version tooltip)
- arpit: prototype +N chip + tray and compact badge glyph
- sasha: write aria-live announcement text and focus management pattern
- lee: propose CSV column name and confirm with eng (version_origin)

maria: ETA: Friday EOD for the next iteration. thanks! :party_popper:
